notes:
Purpose and audience:

The app helps individuals keep rental-property repair, renewal, and inspection records.
Anyone managing rental properties can use it, including people who manage buildings themselves or receive reports from a management company.
Short memos and photos preserve what happened, while a searchable progress list helps people find pending work and earlier repairs.
Room records keep contract dates, rent, residents, and equipment available for the next inquiry.
A shared directory keeps emergency, maintenance, management, insurance, fire-safety, and resident contacts available.
Contract records keep notice deadlines with the agreement dates.

Setup and main features:

The app requires no account, sign-in credentials, sample files, subscription, or paid access.
On first launch, open Properties, labeled `物件`, and tap plus to register a building and its first room.
Open the building, room, and `賃貸借契約`.
Use the toolbar edit action to change a saved property, room, or contract.
In the contract editor, enable `予告期限を記録` and enter a date from the agreement or select the number of months before expiry.
Enable `期限を通知` for a local reminder at 09:00 Japan time on the deadline, with an optional advance reminder.
The app doesn't determine legal notice requirements.
Open Actions, labeled `対応`, and tap plus to add a repair, renewal, or inspection.
Select the building and optional room, enter a title, and save.
Common-area work has no room selection.
Open the saved work item, choose its status, and add short memos with `メモを追加`.
Photos appear within the record.
Use `写真を追加` for the system photo picker or camera.
Use the edit action to record an optional estimate, deadline, and local reminder.
Active work precedes completed work on the same searchable screen.
Completing work and editing a room's contract are separate operations.
Open Contacts, labeled `連絡先`, and tap plus to register a contact.
Select a category, optional emergency priority, and related buildings.
Search by contact information or related building name.
Deleting a contact clears assignments and retains work memos and photos.
The camera and notifications are optional.
Declining permission doesn't prevent saving records.

External services, tools, and platforms:

Core features use Apple's SwiftUI, UIKit, Foundation, Image I/O, system photo picker, camera, Quick Look, and local notifications.
Records and photos stay on the device.
The app has no external data provider, authentication service, payment processor, AI service, advertising SDK, or analytics SDK.
The informational support and privacy website uses Cloudflare Workers.
Core record keeping works offline.
Telephone, email, and website links hand off to system apps after confirmation.
Users keep private records, with no public posting, shared content feed, or user-to-user messaging.

Regional behavior:

App Store availability covers Japan.
The interface is Japanese and amounts use whole yen.
Features work consistently across device regions.

Regulated services and protected content:

The app handles no transactions, brokerage, investment advice, or regulated professional services.
It uses original artwork and Apple's system frameworks and symbols.
The app supplies no protected third-party documents or media.
